title: Recognize God
verse: Now when the centurion, who stood in front of him, saw how he died, he said, “Truly this man was God’s Son!
observation: Even a Roman centurion recognized Jesus’ true identity at the cross.
application: I will live today acknowledging Jesus as Lord and Savior.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for dying for us. We confess You as the Son of God.
